name: Killing Floor 2
description: Co-op wave-based zed slaughter for up to 6 players. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Query port (UDP)
variables.description: Steam query port (default 27015); change it with ?QueryPort= in the start URL.

notes: The Linux binary really does live under Binaries/Win64/. Configuration is written to KFGame/Config/ on first start (LinuxServer-KFGame.ini for game settings, KFWeb.ini to enable the web admin on TCP 8080). Windows hosts: set the start command override to Binaries\Win64\KFServer.exe {{MAP}}?Port={{SERVER_PORT}}.
